_about: One row per number the parry uses. mordhau_property: property on MORDHAU's parry motion definition (Mordhau/Content/Mordhau/Blueprints/Motions/BP_ParryMotion, per-weapon versions under Motions/ParryMotions inherit it), read at runtime from the player's own MORDHAU; null = MORDHAU's data files hold no such number (it lives in the program), so only the fallback exists. fallback: this mod's own value when MORDHAU has none or is not installed. read_ok: the value was read on this PC.

rows.meaning: how long a parry can stop a hit, from the press
time from the press before another parry can start (this mod's reading of the name)
extra time the parry pose is held after the window closes with nothing parried (this mod's reading of the name)
the attacker must be within this angle of where the defender faces
after a parry, an attack started within this time is a riposte
wind-up of a riposte, replacing the weapon's normal wind-up
side-by-side mode: a Skyrim-ruled hit this soon after the parry button counts as parried even if MORDHAU's parry motion has not been streamed back yet (the link's delay)
